name: Hoshifuji Kesuke
source:
Classmate. A “good guy” who kindly offers advice on various things after the protagonist transfers schools.

Quite laid-back. He guides the protagonist on how to navigate life in this town and school, incorporating a male perspective (?).

Eventually becomes the protagonist's best friend. Has narrow eyes.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827979&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
